requirements.quote: Owner and advocate (with owner setting) can assign an appearance with capacity and optional note; the assignee is notified in-app; reassigning records the previous assignee in `audit_event`.
A junior's `Mine` scope in the court-day query returns only their assigned appearances and matters they are permitted to see; unassigned items are invisible to them.

`suggestAssignments` returns proposals only (never writes): it resolves hall and complex clashes by suggesting a different member, explains each reason in one line, and the owner must accept each (L2).
The tomorrow plan view lists all appearances with an assignee picker per row, bulk 'Accept all suggestions' (confirm dialog), and shows unassigned and clashing items first.
requirements.evidence: .github/workflows/e2e.yml (Playwright e2e/a11y specs in e2e/tests/delegation, run in CI)

requirements.quote: The owner sees outcomes live: when a junior confirms an outcome (#62) the owner's board shows the outcome strip and a toast within 5 seconds without reload.

requirements.quote: Clerk can see assignments but not strategy fields or memory; viewer is read-only; a junior cannot assign others.
Delegation to a member who lacks access to a restricted matter is blocked with an explanation and an owner override that grants access explicitly and is audited.
Offboarding hook: `reassignAppearance` supports bulk reassignment from a departing member (used by #18 flows) and leaves history intact.

States: empty ('No appearances to assign for tomorrow'), loading skeleton, error with retry, offline (assignments queue and mark 'Will sync'; conflicts resolved last-writer-visible with a notice), denied.
